Pad Reset Configuration (PadRstCfg) PADCFG_DW0 Bits 31:30 00 = Powergood 
 01 = Deep GPIO Reset
 10 = GPIO Reset
 11 = Reserved
column38:
Pad Mode Default (Pmode) PADCFG_DW0 Bit13:10  
0h = GPIO Controller controls the Pad
 1h = Native Function 1,
 2h = Native Function 2,
 3h = Native Function 3,

column40:
Gpio Output State (High or Low) 
PADCFG_DW0 Bit0 
0 = Drive a level ‘0’ to the TX output pad
1 = Drive a level ‘1’ to the TX output pad
